qas.query:
I am putting together a small reminiscence display about the sort of history television I most often watched for many years. Use the available resource brief to choose exactly two titles for the display case. Return exactly two titles and one short line for each explaining why it belongs.

Available resource brief:
- Queens of the Peninsula — historical drama series about royal marriages, wars, and succession in Portugal and Castile.
- River Line — historical drama series following merchants, guards, and families in a frontier town.
- Stones of the Frontier — documentary series on forts, treaties, and changing borders in western Iberia.
- Voices from the Archive — recorded oral-history programme with testimony from older residents of rural towns.
- The Winter Emperor — historical drama set in a central European court far from Iberia.
- Harvests of Two Kingdoms — documentary on farming, trade, and everyday life across Portugal and Spain.
